_comment: Authoring worksheet, not a runnable case -- see docs/real-corpus-case-authoring-guide.md for the exact mapping onto a schemas/smoke_test.py::SmokeTestCase entry in your own cases.json. Replace every '<REPLACE...>' placeholder; leave other fields at their shown default (null/[]/{}) until you have a real value, never guess to fill a blank.
corpus_id: <REPLACE: the corpus_id you use in your CorpusReference>
document_id: <REPLACE: the specific document within the corpus this case is about>
license_or_public_access_basis: <REPLACE: e.g. 'CC-BY-4.0', 'public domain (US federal government work)', 'user-owned, license confirmed 2026-01-15'>
answer_origin: <REPLACE: one of human_authored_for_pilot | document_verbatim | manual_transcription_from_document | controlled_perturbation_unsupported | controlled_perturbation_contradicted | llm_generated_unverified>
manifest_id: <REPLACE: matches a manifest_id in your manifests.json>
